claim_text: In previously untreated metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC without sensitising EGFR or ALK alterations, adding an immune-checkpoint inhibitor to platinum-based chemotherapy improves overall and progression-free survival compared with the matching chemotherapy control.

initial_evidence.source_title: Pembrolizumab Plus Chemotherapy in Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
initial_evidence.passage_text: The addition of pembrolizumab to standard chemotherapy resulted in significantly longer overall survival and progression-free survival than chemotherapy alone.
OS benefit was sustained with ABCP versus BCP (ITT-WT: 19.5 versus 14.7 mo; hazard ratio = 0.80; 95% confidence interval: 0.67-0.95).

added_evidence.source_title: IMpower132 trial of atezolizumab plus chemotherapy
added_evidence.passage_text: IMpower132 met its co-primary PFS end point but not its co-primary OS end point.
